scope: Opt-in AC1018 same-import TABLE-to-*T1 membership evidence joined to CRC-checked source frames. This does not prove emitted display-geometry equivalence, native rendering, or authorize output.
implementation: The candidate predicate requires the existing verified TABLE projection bundle and checks one *T1 TABLE, one same-name BLOCK_RECORD, one same-name BLOCK callback, reciprocal callback parent handles, a complete 15-member entity map, unique child handles, and the observed seven-MTEXT/eight-LINE profile.

A separate private reader sink selects BLOCK_RECORD 0x9d and BLOCK 0xa6 explicitly. The reader retains each CRC-checked AC1018 source body with its version, decoded-buffer offset, source-map ordinal, offset space and body/handle bit sizes, paired with the parsed model snapshot.

The reader delivers both tickets only after complete DWG read finalization and checks each against the finalized source-frame ledger: handle, offset, ordinal, offset space, Published disposition and one publication.

The adapter retains both tickets under the same import token and generation, checks each source model against its same-import typed callback, and exposes a query separate from output admission. No public DRW_Interface callback or writer policy changed.

The BLOCK_RECORD exposes only a matchesEntityMap comparison, keeping its parser-owned handle vector encapsulated. The candidate compares the ordered 15 child callback handles with the source-bound model sequence.

observations: BLOCK_RECORD 0x9d names *T1 and its parser entity-map count is 15.
BLOCK 0xa6 has parent 0x9d and contains 15 entities.
All 15 entities have parent handle 0x9d: seven MTEXT and eight LINE.
physical_source.result: PASS: callback candidate and reader-issued source-frame query both pass; unrelated HEADER integrity observation remains.

mutation_controls: Changing the selected BLOCK parent handle refuses the membership candidate; restoration passes.
Changing a cached child handle refuses the membership candidate; restoration passes.
Duplicating the *T1 BLOCK_RECORD callback refuses the membership candidate; removal restores the pass.
Swapping adjacent cached entity callbacks refuses the ordered membership candidate; restoring their source order passes.

verification.result: Adapter, library, dwg2dxf and focused test target built; focused CTest passed 1/1; the physical probe passed both callback mutation controls and source-frame queries. git diff --check and receipt JSON parsing passed.

remaining: Compare the emitted 15 display primitives with an independent decoder or native renderer.
Keep TABLE output refused until remaining graph, semantic and transaction gates pass.
fixtures: No DWG/DXF fixture was added to the repository; the existing local scratch source was used.
